sources.notes: Atlas Evaluation Clip #1. Recording is filmed footage of a laptop screen (not a direct camera feed) showing Atlas running live, including its own detection overlay boxes/labels in some frames -- the overlay was used only to help LOCATE interesting frames during selection, never as ground truth (see README.md). Frames selected only from the clean, full-screen street-content portion (t=23.5s to t=68.5s); the first ~23.5s (coding session / webcam / window-switching) was excluded as not representative street content.
